title: 9 一见钟情，的叶修
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

叶修把钱和身份证一起递回来，周珈蓝没接住，身份证掉在地上，几枚硬币滚的到处都是。

老板娘赶紧道歉，“不好意思啊小妹，”蹲下来帮着捡。

周珈蓝也蹲下去，先去捡硬币。

工资还没发下来，她身上的钱满打满算凑不够一百块，回去的机票都不知道怎么买。

可能等一下要再回来，开一台机子，然后想办法找张佳乐要一个红包。周珈蓝谨慎地想。

做这种事她没有心理负担，张佳乐是职业选手中的大神，他有钱又愿意把钱花出去，很正常，没什么不对的。

硬币冰凉的触感滚过指尖。

老板娘把身份证递给她，忽然发现什么，瞪圆眼睛，“周……”

网管叶修及时提醒道，“嘘，老板娘，小点声儿。”

老板娘瞪了他一眼，“你早就知道？”

叶修转眼看别的地方，假装没听见。

周珈蓝还蹲在地上，有点紧张的捂了捂口罩。

叶修察觉到，温和地冲她笑笑，“没事儿。”

“嗯……嗯。”周珈蓝定了定神，捏着硬币从地上站起来。

叶修又冲她笑了笑，耳边是老板娘压低的兴奋声音。

“小蓝！你好漂亮呀，赛场上打的也好漂亮，我好喜欢你呀！你怎么来h市了？哦哦，我知道了，是来找孙翔的是吧？能给我签个名吗？”

周珈蓝拘谨地站着，犹豫了一下还是摘下帽子口罩，这会儿刚好人不多，没人注意到她雪白长发和紫色眼睛。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ye Xiu handed back the money and ID card, but Zhou Jialan didn't catch it. The ID card fell to the ground, and a few coins rolled everywhere.

The proprietress quickly apologized, "I'm sorry, little sister," and knelt down to help pick it up.

Zhou Jialan also squatted down and picked up the coins first.

Her salary hasn't been paid yet, and she doesn't even have enough money to collect 100 yuan, and she doesn't even know how to buy a plane ticket back.

Maybe I'll come back later, turn on a machine, and then find a way to ask Zhang Jiale for a red envelope.Zhou Jialan thought cautiously.

She has no psychological burden for doing this kind of thing. Zhang Jiale is a great player among professional players. He has money and is willing to spend it. It is normal and there is nothing wrong with it.

The cool touch of the coin rolled over my fingertips.

The landlady handed her her ID card and suddenly noticed something. Her eyes widened and she said, "Zhou..."

The network administrator Ye Xiu promptly reminded, "Shh, boss lady, keep your voice down."

The landlady glared at him, "You already knew that?"

Ye Xiu looked away and pretended not to hear.

Zhou Jialan was still squatting on the ground, covering his mask nervously.

Ye Xiu noticed it and smiled gently at her, "It's okay."

"Hmm... um." Zhou Jialan calmed down and stood up from the ground holding the coin.

Ye Xiu smiled at her again, hearing the proprietress's low-pitched excited voice in his ears.

"Xiao Lan! You are so beautiful, and you play so beautifully on the court. I like you so much! Why did you come to H City? Oh, I understand. You are here to see Sun Xiang, right? Can you sign your name for me?"

Zhou Jialan stood cautiously and hesitated before taking off her hat and mask. There were not many people around at this time, so no one noticed her long snow-white hair and purple eyes.
